reserveReview.rationale: Re-read the exact rwaUSDi category feed and proof endpoint at 2026-10-10T23:30:33Z. The category feed metadata timestamp is 2026-10-10T23:27:59.413Z and its signature field accompanies Li Mines $600,000,000 (40%), Commodities (Gold) $450,000,000 (30%), Real Estate $375,000,000 (25%), and Cu Mines $75,000,000 (5%). The four published shares total 100% and all slice and disposition fingerprints remain unchanged. Their $1,500,000,000 total matches the aggregate in proof 6def82e5cb21c621, with data timestamp 2026-10-10T18:30:00Z and TEE attestation generated 2026-10-10T18:30:57.740Z; its reported liabilities are $479,782,100. This review verifies the published category values, not the cryptographic signatures or truth of private inputs. The separate category feed publishes no proof ID, so no cryptographic category-to-proof binding is claimed. AFI's primary pipeline documentation expressly states that computation correctness cannot establish input truth and that individual custodian and asset records are private. Category disclosure supplies composition only: conservative high risk tiers remain, and this observation does not establish financial assurance, instrument-level credit quality, custody safeguards, seniority, maturities, legal enforcement, or recovery. The older Multipli documentation references retain prior context; current retrieval failed and does not refresh those claims.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: AFI rwaUSDi reserve-breakdown feed dated 2026-10-10T23:27:59.413Z: Li Mines $600,000,000 / 40%, Commodities Gold $450,000,000 / 30%, Real Estate $375,000,000 / 25%, Cu Mines $75,000,000 / 5%; same-day proof 6def82e5cb21c621 publishes the matching $1,500,000,000 aggregate
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Category weights are fully disclosed and sum to the verified aggregate, so no share of the composition is unknown. Instrument-level facts sit outside the disclosure: individual obligors and counterparties, the legal form of each position (credit, equity, royalty, or offtake), the gold holding form, custodian identities and shares, seniority, maturities, and valuation marks are committed as private salted fields and are not published.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The AFI data pipeline commits a custodian identifier, asset identifier, and USD value for every reserve record inside the enclave, and the dashboard describes eligible collateral held in approved custody, but no custodian name, share, jurisdiction, segregation term, or bankruptcy-remoteness arrangement is published. Multipli's issuer-custody documentation names institutional-grade counterparty standards for the rwaUSD liquid class and an insurance framework underwritten by Realm without identifying rwaUSDi-specific custodians.
